name: com.unity.ai.navigation
description: The AI Navigation package contains high-level components that allow you to use navmeshes to incorporate navigation and pathfinding in your game. With this package installed you can build and use navmeshes at runtime and at edit time, create dynamic obstacles, and use links to allow specific actions (like jumping) as your characters navigate between navmeshes.

samples.description: A set of examples on how to build and use a dynamic navigation space made of NavMesh surfaces and segment-to-segment connections.

_upm.changelog:
### Fixed
* Fixed NavMesh Surface so that it no longer logs the Console warning that `Camera.onPreCull` is obsolete in Unity 7000.0 and newer. (UUM-160410)
* Fixed a disabled `NavMeshLink` being tracked for position updates as soon as its `autoUpdate` property was set to `true` from a script. ([UUM-161203](https://issuetracker.unity3d.com/product/unity/issues/guid/UUM-161203))
